remarks:
MIXED-USE INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITY – 2 APARTMENTS + COMMERCIAL STOREFRONT

Versatile mixed-use property offering two residential apartments and approximately 2,100 sq. ft. of first-floor commercial space. A great opportunity for an investor or business owner looking for multiple uses and income potential under one roof.

The first apartment features a studio-style layout with a full kitchen offering plenty of cabinet space and a nicely sized full bathroom. The second apartment offers 2 bedrooms, a living room, spacious kitchen, and full bathroom. Both apartments also feature access to large porch areas.

The first-floor commercial space offers approximately 2,100 sq. ft., highlighted by large storefront windows providing excellent natural light and visibility. The space includes a bathroom, several storage rooms, updated flooring, fresh paint, and a new HVAC system. An attached 1-car garage provides additional storage and functionality.

With residential and commercial space all in one property, this building offers flexibility for a variety of business and investment possibilities. Whether adding to an investment portfolio or looking for a location that combines commercial space with residential rental income, this property is ready for its next chapter.
